title: Poisson Regression under Multivariate Sample Selection
abstract: arXiv:2609.21056v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: This paper develops a Poisson regression model with multivariate sample selection, in which the outcome is observed only when several potentially correlated selection conditions are satisfied. To the best of our knowledge, this is the first Poisson sample selection model that allows for an arbitrary number of selection equations. We derive the conditional mean of the observed outcome under joint normality of the outcome and selection errors and obtain a multivariate selection-correction term.   We prove identification of the model parameters and show that, under suitable support and rank conditions, the outcome parameters can be identified without an exclusion restriction. We also propose two-step estimation procedures based on nonlinear least squares and Poisson pseudo-maximum likelihood. translated_title: 多元样本选择下的泊松回归
translated_abstract: 本文建立了一个具有多元样本选择的泊松回归模型，其中结果变量仅在满足若干个可能相关的选择条件时才会被观测到。据我们所知，这是第一个允许任意数量选择方程的泊松样本选择模型。我们在结果误差与选择误差服从联合正态分布的假设下，推导出了被观测结果的条件均值，并得到了一个多元选择修正项。我们证明了模型参数的可识别性，并表明在适当的支撑集和秩条件下，结果参数即使在没有排除性约束的情况下也能被识别。我们还提出了基于非线性最小二乘法和泊松伪极大似然法的两步估计程序。据我们所知，本文首次将PPML应用于带样本选择的泊松回归模型。两种估计量的……（原文摘要在此处被截断）
tldr: 本文提出了首个允许任意数量选择方程的多元样本选择泊松回归模型，证明了在适当条件下无需排除性约束即可识别结果参数，并首次将泊松伪极大似然法（PPML）应用于带样本选择的泊松回归。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes the first Poisson sample selection model that allows an arbitrary number of selection equations, proves identification of outcome parameters without exclusion restrictions under suitable conditions, and is the first to apply Poisson pseudo-maximum likelihood (PPML) to Poisson regression with sample selection.
